V SFX Gold 850 ATX 3.1
• Flexible compatibility• ATX 3.1 support & a 90-degree 12V-2x6 cable• 80 PLUS Gold certified• Fully modular cabling• 100% Japanese capacitors• 10-year Warranty
region
UK
EU
Small But Mighty
As the leading SFX power supply design, the V SFX Gold offers a highly powerful unit in a space-saving, mini form factor.
Flexible compatibility
With the included SFX-to-ATX bracket, the V SFX Gold ATX 3.1 can be used to power systems ranging from as small as a mini-ITX all the way up to E-ATX motherboards.
ATX 3.1 support & a durable 90-degree 12V-2x6 cable
Includes ATX 3.1 support and a 90-degree 12+4pin (12V-2x6) PCIe 5.1 connector featuring higher electrical durability, lower temperatures, and improved safety.
80 PLUS Gold certified
The V SFX Gold is certified to achieve more than 90% efficiency at typical loads.
100% Japanese capacitors
Large, high-quality Japanese capacitors feature improved efficiencyand reduced ripple noise.
Fully modular cabling
Modular cabling reduces clutter, increases airflow, and improves overall thermal performance.
